records.event: The UK Ministry of Defence will issue new contracts for enhanced counter-drone systems as part of Project PRESAGIUM.

resolution_criteria.event: The UK Ministry of Defence will issue new contracts for enhanced counter-drone systems as part of Project PRESAGIUM.
resolution_criteria.threshold: Public announcement or official contract award notice for new contracts under Project PRESAGIUM.
resolution_criteria.ambiguity_policy: If no new contracts are publicly announced or identified in official procurement databases within the timeframe, the forecast resolves as 'does_not_occur'. If evidence is contradictory or insufficient to confirm new contracts, it remains unresolved.

records.event: The British Army will issue requests for information or tenders for FPV drone training systems as part of Project UBIQUITY.

resolution_criteria.event: The British Army will issue requests for information or tenders for FPV drone training systems as part of Project UBIQUITY.
resolution_criteria.threshold: Publication of an official Request for Information (RFI), Request for Proposal (RFP), or similar tender document by the British Army or Ministry of Defence seeking suppliers for FPV drone training systems.
resolution_criteria.ambiguity_policy: If no such document is published within the timeframe, the forecast resolves as 'does_not_occur'. If the scope changes significantly, it remains unresolved.

records.event: The Ministry of Defence will continue to invest in enhanced counter-drone systems.

resolution_criteria.event: The Ministry of Defence will continue to invest in enhanced counter-drone systems.
resolution_criteria.threshold: Public announcement of additional funding, new contracts, or expansion of existing counter-drone system projects (including Project PRESAGIUM) by the UK Ministry of Defence, or official statements confirming ongoing commitment to C-UAS investment.
resolution_criteria.ambiguity_policy: If no further public evidence of continued investment is found within the timeframe, the forecast remains unresolved. General defense spending announcements without specific C-UAS mention will not count.

records.event: The US Air Force will continue to integrate AI-enabled command-and-control (C2) tools into battlefield decision loops.

resolution_criteria.event: The US Air Force will continue to integrate AI-enabled command-and-control (C2) tools into battlefield decision loops.
resolution_criteria.threshold: Public announcement or documented evidence of further AI-enabled C2 tool integration, experimentation, or deployment beyond the initial DASH sprint, specifically aimed at operational use or shortening decision loops.
resolution_criteria.ambiguity_policy: If evidence is contradictory or insufficient to confirm integration, the forecast remains unresolved. General AI research without specific C2 integration will not count.

records.event: The British Army will continue to seek suppliers for FPV drone training systems.

resolution_criteria.event: The British Army will continue to seek suppliers for FPV drone training systems.
resolution_criteria.threshold: Public announcement or official tender document from the British Army or Ministry of Defence seeking suppliers for FPV drone training systems.
resolution_criteria.ambiguity_policy: If no new public announcements or official tender documents are found within the timeframe, the event will remain unresolved. Contradictory evidence (e.g., official cancellation of the search) will resolve as 'does_not_occur'.

records.event: Northrop Grumman's one-way attack drone will continue to utilize jam-proof navigation systems based on Earth's magnetic field, developed by SandboxAQ.

resolution_criteria.event: Northrop Grumman's one-way attack drone will continue to utilize jam-proof navigation systems based on Earth's magnetic field, developed by SandboxAQ.
resolution_criteria.threshold: Public announcement or leaked information confirming further development, testing, or integration of SandboxAQ's magnetic field navigation system in Northrop Grumman's one-way attack drones.
resolution_criteria.ambiguity_policy: If no confirming evidence is found, or if contradictory evidence emerges (e.g., Northrop Grumman abandons the technology), the forecast remains unresolved. If the system is adopted for other drone types, it will still count as resolved.
